coaching.headline: We edged the kills 19-18 and won four fights in a row — but cashed only one, lost the majors ledger 14-29, and the base fell within a minute of the final 2-5 teamfight.
coaching.team: From 17.5 to 26 we won four straight skirmishes, all 2-1, and converted exactly one — the sheet shows 17.5, 21.5 and 23 left on the table, and even the won fight at 26 ended with our carry dead and three towers falling by 27.1. The 27.8 Primal Fangtooth teamfight was a fair trade — we lost it 2-3 but took Primal Fangtooth in the same window — though it was also taken three items down by the gold model, 9 to their 12: a timing miss, not a mechanics one. The clean losses got cashed hard: the 30.6 fight at our inner tower preceded their Orb Prime at 32.1, and the 34.2 teamfight went 2-5 with all five deaths ahead of the inhibitors and the Core at 35. Draft-and-build lesson: their damage was led by Gadget's 61k magical — magic resist was the missing answer.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Minute 30.6. A fight started at our inner tower while Mr_Meat31's Legion was pinned in a losing carry lane and the midlaner, alive, never joined — we lost it 1-2 and they cashed the window into Orb Prime at 32.1, Genesis Core at 32 and Primal Fangtooth at 33. With a lane pinned and a body not coming, the better call was to reset, hold the tower, and meet them at Orb Prime five strong; instead the 34.2 fight was played from behind on the map and the base fell by 35.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 drew one of the two paper-unfavored lanes (the jungle read against us too) — Legion into Murdock, read 'theirs all game' — and it played to script at 1/3/5. Two game reads matter more than the scoreline: his death in the won fight at 26 preceded three towers falling between 26.4 and 27.1, so a won fight that ends with the carry dead is a fight to leave a beat earlier; and at 30.6 the macro note has him pinned in a losing lane when the fight started — that one is on the fight call, not on Legion. On the build, Vanquisher was the missing core piece.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Phase won the support matchup on paper all game and backed it up — 1/1/6, 16,990 healing, and 23 wards. The one flag is the 27.8 Primal Fangtooth teamfight: the macro read has her alive and ahead in lane, and a shove-and-rotate there flips a 2-3 into a numbers advantage — a support's healing only counts in the fights she reaches. The lane was held; the next step is turning that safety into presence at the fights that decide the map.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath, Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

gadget.loadout: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot), augment Auto-Lock Amp, crest Soulbearer
fedBy: Field Data Accumulation (passive): Gadget acquires stacks of FDA that permanently grant 1 magical power for every 6 stacks gained. Minion & Monster Kills grant 1 stack. Damaging Enemy Heroes with abilties grants 5 stacks, once per activation. Takedowns grant 20 stacks.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,756 hero damage a minute, more than 93% of Gadget mid players this patch (39% of the team's). The damage came from Soulbinder, Combustion, Entropy.
Tesla Dome at rank 3: 95s base, about 62.1s by the end (35% shorter) from 53 ability haste: Soulbinder 20, Azure Core 10, Entropy 15, Soulbearer 8.
11 takedowns (5 kills, 6 assists) fed: Field Data Accumulation (passive).
Gadget dealt 61,445 hero damage, 39% of their team's, with +460 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9; against Legion (level 16: about 44 magical armor, 35 after penetration; took 11,702 magical damage from heroes, 58% of all hero damage they took) and Howitzer (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 40 after penetration; took 24,131 magical damage from heroes, 74% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Soulbinder (item): Damage Heroes from afar with Abilities: Deal 8% bonus Damage. Activates at 1450+ Range.
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 21% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 2,643 healing recorded.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Entropy, Vesh, Mind Rot. Gadget has 4 damaging abilities (Seek and Destroy, Sticky Mine, Tesla Dome hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 53 ability haste brought them back 35% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Soulbearer, Lich.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Gadget killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Howitzer, Greystone, Yurei. We killed Gadget 2 times.
Copy it? Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot): 44.1% in 598 Gadget midlane games, below the hero's 50%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Tesla Dome came back about every 62s instead of 95s by the end (35% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

greystone.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Close Cut, crest Judgement
lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 2,141 damage mitigated a minute, more than 91% of Greystone offlane players this patch.
Stone Forged Soul at rank 3: 145s base, about 103.6s by the end (29% shorter) from 40 ability haste: Tainted Blade 10, Augmentation 20, Gaia Greaves 10.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Greystone dealt 43,155 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +192 physical power from items.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Target: Cause them to take 5% more damage for 3s.
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Gaia Greaves (item): Move to generate up to 100 stacks: Stacks grant up to 40 Movement Speed. Basic Attacks expend all stacks for bonus Damage. Deals up to 40 (+60%)(+5%) Damage.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Close Cut (augment): Make Way deals 20% increased damage to the nearest Enemy Unit.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 4% omnivamp; Tainted Blade: On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.; Salvation: On going below 30% Health: Gain a (+25%) Shield for 6s. Reduced to 50% Effectiveness for Ranged Heroes. Gain 10% Omnivamp for 6s.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 19,957 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1525 health, +50 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 75,672 damage, mitigated 74,943, died 4 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Augmentation, Gaia Greaves, Sky Splitter, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Tainted Blade, Salvation, Sky Splitter, Judgement, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Greystone killed built physical armor (Crunch). No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Greystone 4 times.

Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 50.3% in 2,224 Greystone offlane games, below the hero's 51.9%; this 3-item core: 58.6% in 145 games, above the 57.6% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

card.lesson: Stone Forged Soul came back about every 104s instead of 145s by the end (29% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
